merge.metaTitle: Merge PDF – Combine PDF files online for free
merge.metaDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in seconds. Put the files in order, then download. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
merge.lead: Combine PDFs into one file in the order you want. Everything runs in your browser, so your files never leave your device.
merge.cardText: Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
howTo: Select or drop two or more PDF files.
Drag the files, or use the arrows, to set their order.
Optionally name the merged file, then click Merge PDF.

faq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Merging happens entirely in your browser, and your files are never sent to our servers.

faq.q: How many files can I merge?
faq.a: Up to {maxFiles} PDF files with a combined size of up to {maxSize}.

faq.q: Are bookmarks and form fields kept?
faq.a: Pages, text and images are kept. Bookmarks and fillable form fields may not carry over.

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, in any modern browser on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.
